articles.title: Strategy proposes daily dividends to bring STRC back toward $100
articles.snippet: STRC has remained below $100 since May, despite a 12% dividend rate and roughly $1 billion in preferred share buybacks.

articles.title: Someone was trying to sell Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death
articles.snippet: The company has vehemently denied that it was shopping for buyers. Allman’s estate declined to comment.

articles.title: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
articles.snippet: The U.S derivatives regulator is grinding away at further guidance that welcomes tokenization and blockchain recordkeeping as regular industry elements.

articles.title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang’s death ruled a suicide
articles.snippet: The crypto executive and Dystopia Labs founder previously held senior roles at Stellar and Solana before joining venture capital firm Hack VC.

articles.title: CoinMarketCap buys CoinGlass to expand crypto derivatives data
articles.snippet: CoinGlass will retain its brand and team, while its website, app, free tools, API and pricing will remain unchanged following the acquisition.
